en.hubeali: And by his chain, from Al Halby who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the man who emancipated his concubine, is it correct for him that he marries her without a waiting period?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said:’ Yes’. I said, ‘So others?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No, until she observes the waiting period of three months’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘And I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a man who fell upon (copulated with) his slave girl, is it correct for him that he marries her before he observes the waiting period?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No’. I said, ‘How much is her waiting period?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘One menstruation or two’.
